implementation: Keycorp MULTOS I4F 80K with MULTOS PIV Card Application
description: The Keycorp MULTOS I4F 80K Smart Card with MULTOS PIV Card Application can be employed in a wide range of solutions. The smart card provides a highly portable, secure token for enhancing the security of network access and ensuring secure electronic communications. Combined with the PIV Card Application it provides enhanced I&A functionality.
